G'oya

Har talabaning yozilishlarini vaqt bo'yicha tizamiz va ikki uchidagi qatorni olamiz. Ikki uchini topishning qulay yo'li ikkita ROW_NUMBER: biri o'sish tartibida, biri kamayish tartibida. Ikkalasida ham 1-raqam kerakli qator. Keyin har talabaning qatorlarini bitta qatorga yig'amiz.

Yechim

WITH r AS (
  SELECT e.student_id, c.title,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.student_id
                            ORDER BY e.enrolled_on, e.id) AS rn_first,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.student_id
                            ORDER BY e.enrolled_on DESC, e.id DESC) AS rn_last
  FROM enrollments e
  JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
)
SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.name,
       MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn_first = 1 THEN r.title END) AS first_course,
       MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn_last = 1 THEN r.title END) AS last_course
FROM students s
JOIN r ON r.student_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
ORDER BY s.id

MAX(CASE ...) bu yerda "bitta qiymatni olib chiqish" uchun: guruhda rn_first = 1 bo'lgan qator bitta, qolganlarida CASE NULL beradi.

Tuzoqlar

LAST_VALUE ning standart freymi oxirgi qatorni emas, joriy qatorni ko'radi. ORDER BY bo'lgan oynada freym RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW, ya'ni "boshidan shu qatorgacha". Uning oxirgi qiymati shu qatorning o'zi. Freymni ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING qilib kengaytirish kerak:

SELECT DISTINCT s.id AS student_id, s.name,
       FIRST_VALUE(c.title) OVER w AS first_course,
       LAST_VALUE(c.title) OVER w AS last_course
FROM enrollments e
JOIN students s ON s.id = e.student_id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY e.student_id ORDER BY e.enrolled_on, e.id
             ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
ORDER BY s.id

MIN(c.title) va MAX(c.title) birinchi va oxirgi kursni emas, alifbo bo'yicha birinchi va oxirgisini beradi. Namunada Aziz uchun bu Analitika va SQL asoslari, to'g'ri javob esa Excel va Analitika.

Bekzod ikki kursga bir kunda yozilgan. Tartibda id bo'lmasa, qaysi biri "birinchi" ekanini baza o'zi tanlaydi.
